en.title: Find Maximum Two-Digit Fragment
en.description: Among all contiguous fragments of length 2 in a digit string, find the maximum value when each fragment is interpreted as a decimal number.
en.input: One line containing a digit string S of length 2..100000, consisting only of the characters 0..9.
en.output: Output the value of the largest two-digit fragment; a leading zero is parsed as an integer.
en.explanation: Derive a linear scan/dynamic programming solution directly from the problem rules; the examples have been checked one by one against an independently built oracle.
hints: First turn the operations or constraints in the statement into a well-defined array/state transition, then analyze the boundaries.
